recognize_zh: 拼圖 B 可見一顆明顯增大、帶有大型核內包涵體的細胞（CMV 細胞病變），插圖為 CMV 免疫染色陽性；E 的免疫染色只圈出濾泡周圍的一圈外套區（mantle zone）而中央生發中心陰性，顯示腫瘤細胞侷限於外套區生長——這是外套細胞淋巴瘤外套區型（mantle zone pattern）的線索，容易被 CMV 淋巴結炎的反應性表現掩蓋。
features: Composite of lymph node sections (A–F); antigens for panels C–F are not labeled in the image
A: low-power H&E lymph node with preserved nodular architecture; inset shows small-to-medium lymphoid cells
B: high-power H&E with a markedly enlarged cell containing a large amphophilic intranuclear inclusion (CMV cytopathic effect); inset shows an inclusion-bearing cell positive by immunostain
C: low-power immunostain with diffuse strong staining of most of the node surrounding paler nodules
D and E: immunostains outlining rings of positive cells around negative follicle centers, i.e., a mantle zone distribution
F: immunostain with numerous positive cells concentrated in a band around a follicle
describe_en: Composite lymph node sections show, at low power, a node with preserved follicular/nodular architecture composed of small-to-medium lymphoid cells (A). High power reveals scattered markedly enlarged cells with large intranuclear inclusions consistent with cytomegalovirus cytopathic effect, confirmed by immunostaining of an inclusion-bearing cell (B, inset). Immunohistochemical stains (antigens not labeled in the figure) show positive cells arranged as expanded rings around negative germinal centers, highlighting a mantle zone growth pattern (C–F); confirmation of cyclin D1 or SOX11 positivity in these mantle cells is required to establish the diagnosis. In context, the findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern co-occurring with CMV lymphadenitis.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with CMV lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Reactive mantle zones are thin and polytypic and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 negative, whereas neoplastic mantle cells are cyclin D1 positive and light chain restricted.
In situ mantle cell neoplasm shows cyclin D1-positive cells confined to the inner mantle of otherwise normal-sized mantle zones, rather than expanded mantle zones or nodal effacement.
MZL cells surround follicles outside the mantle zone and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
EBV-associated changes show immunoblasts that are EBER positive without intranuclear viral inclusions, which in this case are CMV positive.
